x.body:
Ten minutes of reading sounds lovely at lunch. At 11 pm, the same ten minutes can keep the book shut.

That's why I put a second option in Ssak: pick one page while you’re making the plan. When bedtime comes, the only decision left is which page to open.

instagram.caption:
Choose the small version while you still have energy. Ten minutes on an ordinary night, one page on a busy one. After reading, log the option you finished. What’s your one-page equivalent?

One habit free on iOS & Android. Book illustration and web demo with sample data; mobile layout may differ. #ReadingHabit #Bookstagram
instagram.format: 15 seconds, 720x1280, H.264, silent; original illustrated book scenes and archived English web demo
